description: N5: a fly WITHOUT our layer WallSense in Fly learns, measured (not live): the learning brain of Fly learns (controls_learn.json, the leg reflex after 50 tics, the authored visible-target assist), Freedoom, skill 3, 2 minutes per run; per place (the WAD and the map, as WallSense keys them) the median over the runs of the % of the time pushing against a wall in each 15 s. tests/doomfly/FlyLearnMeasure.cpp --learning 1 --wall-sense 0 --iwad freedoom1.wad --map <m> --seed 1..5 --skill 3 --bin-seconds 15 --max-minutes 2. The curve of Fly learns draws it as the white line next to the fly that learns.
